title: Editor Crash when using "Mobile" Rendering Method in 4.8
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.8.dev.gh [c3e6b2c09] (current master as of this writing)
- Reproducible in v4.8.dev [f964fa714f503bd063b96f6194eb3e45355c1084]
- NOT Reproducible in v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]

Working on bisect.

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (c3e6b2c09) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9227) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 31.34 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When launching a project with it's rendering method set to "mobile", it crashes.

Video of the crash:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2ec058ee-70e9-4a4a-87c7-596b5702a8c9

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP

or

1. Create a new project
2. Set the Rendering Method to Mobile (Project Settings > Rendering > Renderer > Rendering Method)
3. Exit
4. Open the project
